title: How BestChatBot Runs a Separate Support Bot for Each Client #shorts
description:
One support bot for all your clients can leak one client's data into another. 

BestChatBot gives each client their own isolated workspace, so every bot is trained only on that client's docs. 

Run a real bot per client from one account. 

Try it free: https://bestchatbot.io
